summary: Phase 4 testing completed successfully. All quickstart/integration kit features work correctly. Bootstrap API key auto-seeded, quickstart endpoints functional, frontend UI renders properly with all elements, and all Phase 1-3 features still work (regression passed).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/quickstart returns base_url, api_key (wnk_*), api_key_id, demo_license (WNX-*), and endpoints
Backend: POST /api/admin/quickstart/test runs real activate->validate->deactivate cycle with 3 steps, valid:true, mode:online
Backend: POST /api/admin/quickstart/rotate-key rotates key, revokes old key (401), new key works
Backend: Running /api/admin/quickstart/test 4 times succeeds (seat recycling works with 3-seat demo license)
Backend: Bootstrap api_key works with /api/integrate/activate end-to-end (hardware_id=abc, domain=example.com)
Frontend: Admin login successful, sidebar shows Quickstart entry
Frontend: Dashboard shows quickstart banner 'Tie WatchNexus into your app suite' linking to /admin/quickstart
Frontend: /admin/quickstart page renders without console errors
Frontend: All UI elements present (API key card with wnk_ chip, Base URL card, Demo license card with WNX- chip, Run test button, Rotate key button)
Frontend: All 5 code snippet tabs present (curl, Python, JavaScript, .NET, Drop-in client)
Frontend: Run test button shows 3 step result cards with correct labels and JSON (activate, validate with valid:true mode:online, deactivate with ok:true)
Frontend: Switching tabs updates code blocks visibly, all snippets contain bootstrap API key
Frontend: Rotate bootstrap key shows confirm dialog and rotates key (confirmed by toast notification)
REGRESSION: Customer portal /portal redirects to /portal/login without pre-auth fetches or errors
REGRESSION: Customer register and login works, portal dashboard loads without 401s
REGRESSION: All Phase 2+3 admin pages work (licenses, products, api-keys with allowlist, webhooks with Stripe, builds, customers, audit)
